theorems.statement: ∀ (n N N' : ℕ) (M S : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn N'), Chapter02.IsSimonSubmanifold (E := Rn n) 1 M → (∀ (V : Set (Rn n)) (W : Set (Rn N)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N), Chapter02.IsSimonLocalRepresentation 1 M V W ψ → ∀ x ∈ V, tangentSpace M (ψ x) = LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ x).toLinearMap) → MeasurableSet S → S ⊆ M → (∀ y ∈ S, DifferentiableAt ℝ f y) → (∀ y ∈ S, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ f y)) → InjOn f S → μHE[n] (f '' S) = ∫⁻ y in S, ENNReal.ofReal (areaJacobian ((fderiv ℝ f y).comp (tangentSpace M y).subtypeL)) ∂μHE[n]
